<!-- ===== SECTION 02 — COMPANY STORY ===== -->
<section class="ab-story band-white" id="story" data-screen-label="Company Story">
  <div class="container">
    <div class="ab-story-grid">
      <div>
        <span class="eyebrow">WHO WE ARE</span>
        <h2>We built Kleza because small businesses deserved the same AI advantage as the <span class="ital">enterprises that could afford it.</span></h2>
        <p>Kleza was founded in 2016 with a single conviction: that true progress comes from getting the balance right between technology and human expertise. Not AI as a replacement for people &mdash; AI as a precision instrument in the hands of people who know what they&rsquo;re doing.</p>
        <p>Today, 75% of our work is in healthcare &mdash; an industry where the stakes of getting AI wrong are higher than almost anywhere else. We serve home care agencies, hospitals, pharmacies, and health-tech companies across the USA, with a delivery team of 40+ specialists operating from Hyderabad, India.</p>
        <p>We are Kleza Solutions &mdash; and our product is the intelligence, the engineering, and the human care that powers the work of caring for others.</p>
      </div>
      <div class="ab-pullquote">
        <span class="mk">&ldquo;</span>
        <p>With Kleza, you&rsquo;re not choosing a service. You&rsquo;re choosing a smarter way to grow.</p>
      </div>
    </div>
    <div class="ab-facts">
      <div class="ab-fact"><div class="n">2016</div><div class="l">Founded</div></div>
      <div class="ab-fact"><div class="n">USA + India</div><div class="l">Locations</div></div>
      <div class="ab-fact"><div class="n">40+</div><div class="l">Team members</div></div>
      <div class="ab-fact"><div class="n">75%</div><div class="l">Healthcare-focused</div></div>
    </div>

<!-- ===== SECTION 03 — VISION ===== -->
<section class="ab-vision" id="vision" data-screen-label="AI Transformation Vision">
  <div class="container">
    <div class="ab-vision-grid">
      <div>
        <span class="eyebrow">OUR VISION</span>
        <h2>AI is not the future of healthcare. <span class="ital">AI plus human judgment is.</span></h2>
      </div>
      <div class="ab-principles">
        <div class="ab-principle"><div class="pn">01</div><h3>Precision over generalisation</h3><p>Generic AI gives generic answers. Every system Kleza builds is trained on domain-specific data &mdash; producing outputs that earn clinical trust rather than demanding it.</p></div>
        <div class="ab-principle"><div class="pn">02</div><h3>Humans in the loop, always</h3><p>No Kleza AI system operates without human oversight. We design escalation paths, review cycles, and quality checks into every deployment &mdash; because technology that replaces human judgment in healthcare is a risk, not a feature.</p></div>
        <div class="ab-principle"><div class="pn">03</div><h3>Intelligence that improves over time</h3><p>We build AI that learns from operational reality &mdash; models that get more accurate as your data evolves, not systems that decay after deployment.</p></div>
      </div>
    </div>
    <div class="ab-vision-quote"><span class="mk">&ldquo;</span><p>The most powerful technology in healthcare is not the one that replaces the caregiver. It is the one that makes the caregiver more capable.</p></div>
  </div>
</section>

<!-- ===== SECTION 04 — HEALTHCARE ===== -->
<section class="ab-hc-dark" id="healthcare" data-screen-label="Healthcare Innovation">
  <div class="container">
    <div class="ab-hc-grid">
      <div>
        <span class="eyebrow">HEALTHCARE INNOVATION</span>
        <h2>75% healthcare. <span class="ital">100% intentional.</span></h2>
        <p>Healthcare is not a vertical we entered for market size. It is the industry where the need for intelligent, reliable, human-centred technology is most acute &mdash; and where the consequences of poor technology are most serious.</p>
        <p>Our healthcare clients include home care agencies, long-term care facilities, pharmacies, staffing organisations, and health-tech companies. We understand their regulatory environment, their staffing challenges, their documentation burden, and the human cost of getting any of it wrong.</p>
      </div>
      <div class="ab-hc-stats">
